restDivergence.why: REST cannot read merge-queue removal history, so the removed merge-group failure is invisible and the head looks READY; 133/134 cover REST with carried-over removal evidence.

description: --merge is enabled and GitHub removed the PR from the merge queue with reason MERGE_CONFLICT and no actor (the queue's own merge commit conflicted with an entry ahead of it). There is no failed merge-group check to triage, so iterate returns the bounded investigation TRIAGE; the agent updates the head from the base and pushes.
